name: manimchem
description: Chemistry for Manim: 2D and 3D molecules from PubChem or .mol files, Bohr atoms, orbitals, element cards and periodic tables
author: SavithOnline

objects.name: Molecule
objects.description: A molecule drawn flat, from PubChem by name or from a .mol file's text

params.name: pubchem
params.label: PubChem name
params.tooltip: Any name PubChem knows: water, aspirin, glucose...

params.name: mol
params.label: .mol text
params.tooltip: Paste a .mol file to draw it instead of the PubChem name

objects.name: 3D molecule
objects.description: A ball-and-stick molecule from PubChem's 3D record; turn the camera of a 3D scene to see it in depth

params.name: mol
params.label: .mol text
params.tooltip: Paste a .mol file with 3D coordinates to draw it instead

objects.name: Bohr atom
objects.description: Electrons on their shells around a nucleus of protons and neutrons

params.name: seed
params.label: Nucleus layout
params.tooltip: Change it to arrange the protons and neutrons another way

objects.name: Orbital
objects.description: An atomic orbital's shape: its positive lobes in one color, its negative ones in another

objects.name: Element card
objects.description: One element's card: its number, symbol, name and color

objects.name: Periodic table
objects.description: All 118 elements, each in its color

objects.name: Formula
objects.description: A formula with its numbers written small, like H2SO4

animations.name: Spin
animations.description: Turns the object about its center

animations.name: Orbit electrons
animations.description: Moves the electrons around their shells, the outer ones slower
